text:
Elaine: Quick experiment — launching a small tweak to the pricing page package selector. Microcopy + a lightweight 'estimate' slider. Goal: measure drop-off between FAQ and interactive estimator and test new 'commitment badge' phrasing. Plan to roll out to 10% of users on Wed 9am PT. Need: tracking events, A/B exposure, and inbound routing mapping. Thoughts?

Sam_G: Love it. Can we include a variant that hides the monthly/annual toggle? Want to isolate 'commitment' effect.

Devon_growth: Tracking plan sounds good. I'll add GTM events and GA4 funnel. Event names I'm using: package_select_view, package_estimate_interaction, faq_expand, estimate_submit. Will set up funnel by cohort and by variant.

Maria_prod: Also want to forward intent signals to sales: rule proposal — estimate_submit with est_value >= 500 => sales lead; 100-499 => nurture sequence; <100 => self-serve. Sales, confirm thresholds?

Alex_sales: Confirmed. Also can CS add a short FAQ blurb about Dedicated and data residency so reps have a macro. I'll draft the macro after assets land.

Nina_design: I'll push the updated microcopy and the slider component to Figma (link in channel). Tiny UX note: show “Estimated monthly spend” in bold and surface a tooltip on Commitment badge.

Devon_growth: Dev snippet for engineers:
```
// GTM dataLayer push
dataLayer.push({
  event: 'estimate_submit',
  value: est_value,
  plan: plan_id
});
```
I'll also create a dedicated Salesforce mapping: Lead.Source = 'pricing_tool', Lead.Tool_Value = est_value.

Priya_eng: Can do the rollout. I'll create a LaunchDarkly flag `pricing_funnel_playtest` with two keys: `control` and `micro_estimator_v1`. Will route 10% of eligible traffic to the variant. Need the exact variant keys and the event schema from Devon.

Devon_growth: Added schema above. Variant keys: 'control', 'micro_estimator_v1'. I'll set up the GA4 funnel and a dashboard for the 72h test window.

Alex_sales: One more — if a user picks 'Enterprise' or est_value >= 2000, trigger a short webinar invite flow: 15-min product overview + SLA discussion. I'll draft the copy and share.

Elaine: :thumbsup: Great. Can everyone sync tomorrow 10am PT for 20 minutes? I'll assemble a one-pager experiment brief and post it here beforehand.

deploy-bot: pricing_funnel_playtest flag created in LaunchDarkly; rollout scheduled for Wed 09:00 PT.

Elaine: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll follow up with the brief and the traffic QA checklist.
